name: Enormous Phantom Wolf
biography: A massive phantom wolf with keen senses and a powerful bite.

items.name: Superior Darkvision
items.description: The wolf can see in dim light within 120 feet of itself as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. It can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

items.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
items.description: The wolf has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

items.name: Pack Tactics
items.description: The wolf has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.description: The wolf has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Regeneration
items.description: The wolf regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point.

items.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
items.description: If the wolf fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

items.name: Multiattack
items.description: The wolf makes two Bite attacks.

items.name: Bite
items.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 33 (4d12 + 7) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. A Medium or smaller target is grappled (escape DC 17) and restrained while grappled.
